releaseNotes: v1.1.2 -- Bugfix + debug logging. v1.1.1 fixed a polling bug where device schedules stacked duplicates on every app save instead of replacing them, which could trip Hubitat's excessive-hub-load protection (LimitExceededException in Logs). v1.1.2 adds debug logging across token/auth lifecycle and poll response outcomes -- helps diagnose a snapshot tile going stale, and dropped/no-response polls on wired/PoE devices (e.g. Duo 3V), where a no-response result is a real issue rather than expected battery-conservation behavior. Update recommended for anyone on 1.1.0 who hit excessive-hub-load errors.
